note: Human/agent trace acceptance scenarios; file validation does not execute these.

scenarios.prompt: 내가 부를 오리지널 곡을 처음부터 만들어줘.
must: Make provisional musical choices; deliver the full delegated draft or state the execution limit.
must_not: Do not force the user to specify theory terms; do not label a loop as a completed song.

scenarios.prompt: 후렴의 드럼만 바꿔. 멜로디와 베이스는 그대로.
must: Inspect the actual chorus span and protect all other material.
must_not: No whole-song rewrite or unrelated instrumentation changes.

must: Fit intended sung syllables to the supplied melody.
must_not: No unsolicited tempo/arrangement edits; no Chinese-only counting rule.

must: Allow stable harmony and symmetric repeating structure.
must_not: No compulsory chorus, vocals, energy drop or modulation.

must: Identify which role each reference influences.
must_not: No fixed genre allowlist or accidental unrelated genre rewrite.

scenarios.prompt: 이 흥얼거린 멜로디는 살리고 반주를 만들어줘.
must: Keep original audio and mark transcription uncertainty; protect the melody.
must_not: No claim of hearing without audio access; no silent melodic replacement.

must: Preserve original audio and use a verified editing path.
must_not: Do not replace with a synthesized voice or pretend unexposed Melodyne control.

must: Inspect accessible evidence or state that the audio was not heard.
must_not: No invented BPM, instrumentation or listening claim.

scenarios.prompt: 지금 갖고 있는 음원과 샘플만 써.
must: Use available local instruments and licensed sources.
must_not: No purchases, credit consumption or private audio upload.

must: Check actual connection and tools, and state missing execution capabilities.
must_not: No imaginary MCP calls or claim that MIDI equals an .als Set.

scenarios.prompt: 지난 작업에서 베이스 한 음만 고치자.
must: Read session state and actual files/Live data before editing.
must_not: No assumption that an old planned edit was executed.

scenarios.prompt: 멜로디는 그대로 두고 브리지 화성만 더 긴장감 있게 바꿔줘.
must: Use relevant harmony/voice-leading knowledge within the bridge.
must_not: No compulsory global complexity increase or changes to the protected melody.
